legend: This is an interactive problem. Your program will interact with the judge using standard input and output.
You are given an array a$$$a$$$ of n$$$n$$$ positive integers and an integer k$$$k$$$, where 2k≤n$$$2k \leq n$$$. You have an initial score equal to 0$$$0$$$.
You will be asked k$$$k$$$ queries. For each query, you will be given an integer x∈{1,2}$$$x \in \{1, 2\}$$$. You must choose an index i$$$i$$$ (1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$) such that†$$$^\dagger$$$:
The index i$$$i$$$ has not been chosen in any previous query;
Whenever you choose some index i$$$i$$$ in some query, the value of ai$$$a_i$$$ is added to the score.
Your task is to maximize the score after completing all k$$$k$$$ queries.
input: The first line contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (2≤2k≤n≤105$$$2 \le 2k \le n \le 10^5$$$).
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤109$$$1 \le a_i \le 10^9$$$).
The interaction proceeds as follows for k$$$k$$$ times:
The judge will output a single integer x∈{1,2}$$$x \in \{1, 2\}$$$.
You must respond with a single integer i$$$i$$$ (1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$) that satisfies the conditions above†$$$^\dagger$$$.
The judge will output "1" if i$$$i$$$ is divisible by x$$$x$$$ and it has not been chosen before in any previous query, and "0" otherwise.

If your program makes an invalid response, then the judge's response will be "0". After receiving such a response, your program should immediately terminate to receive the verdict Wrong Answer. Otherwise, it may receive any other verdict.
After responding to a query, do not forget to output the end of the line and flush the output. Otherwise, you will get Idleness limit exceeded. To do this, use:
see the documentation for other languages.
note: The size of the array is 6 and there are 3 queries. The first 2 lines describe the array and the number of queries.

In the first query, we must choose an index divisible by 1$$$1$$$, we choose the index 1$$$1$$$ and since it's divisible by 1$$$1$$$ and has not been chosen before, the judge will print 1$$$1$$$ to confirm that the chosen index is valid.

In the second query, we must choose an index divisible by 1$$$1$$$, we choose the index 6$$$6$$$ and since it's divisible by 1$$$1$$$ and has not been chosen before, the judge will print 1$$$1$$$ to confirm that the chosen index is valid. Note that if we chose 1$$$1$$$ instead the judge will print 0$$$0$$$ (since it has been chosen before).

In the third query, we must choose an index divisible by 2$$$2$$$, we choose the index 4$$$4$$$ and since it's divisible by 2$$$2$$$ and has not been chosen before, the judge will print 1$$$1$$$ to confirm that the chosen index is valid. Note that if we chose 6$$$6$$$ instead the judge will print 0$$$0$$$ (since it has been chosen before), and if we chose 3$$$3$$$ the judge will also print 0$$$0$$$ (since it's not divisible by 2$$$2$$$).

Note that over all combinations of: two indices divisible by 1 and one index divisible by 2, the maximum possible result is 15 (which is equal to the result in the example) and all chosen indices are distinct and satisfy the divisibility condition, so the result is considered correct.

legend.ai: 这是一个交互题。你的程序将通过标准输入和标准输出与评测器进行交互。
给定一个包含 n$$$n$$$ 个正整数的数组 a$$$a$$$，以及一个整数 k$$$k$$$，其中 2k≤n$$$2k \leq n$$$。你的初始分数为 0$$$0$$$。
你将被要求处理 k$$$k$$$ 次查询。对于每次查询，你会得到一个整数 x∈{1,2}$$$x \in \{1, 2\}$$$。你必须选择一个下标 i$$$i$$$(1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$)，使得†$$$^\dagger$$$：
下标 i$$$i$$$ 能被 x$$$x$$$ 整除；
下标 i$$$i$$$ 尚未在之前的任何查询中被选取；
每当你在某次查询中选择某个下标 i$$$i$$$ 时，ai$$$a_i$$$ 的值就会被加入得分。
你的任务是在完成全部 k$$$k$$$ 次查询后使得分最大。

input.ai: 交互过程将进行 k$$$k$$$ 次，具体如下：
评测器将输出一个整数 x∈{1,2}$$$x \in \{1, 2\}$$$。
你必须回复一个满足上述条件†$$$^\dagger$$$的整数 i$$$i$$$(1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$)。
如果 i$$$i$$$ 能被 x$$$x$$$ 整除，且此前的任何查询中都未选择过它，评测器将输出 "1"；否则输出 "0"。
如果你的程序作出无效响应，评测器的响应将为 "0"。收到此类响应后，你的程序应立即终止，以获得判定结果 Wrong Answer。否则，它可能会得到其他任何判定结果。
对查询作出回复后，不要忘记输出行尾并刷新输出。否则，你将得到 Idleness limit exceeded。要做到这一点，请使用：
C++ 中的 fflush(stdout) 或 cout.flush()；

note.ai: 数组的大小为 6，共有 3 个查询。前 2 行描述数组和查询的数量。
在第一次查询中，我们必须选择一个能被 1$$$1$$$ 整除的下标，我们选择下标 1$$$1$$$，由于它能被 1$$$1$$$ 整除且之前尚未被选择，评测器将输出 1$$$1$$$，以确认所选下标有效。
在第二次查询中，我们必须选择一个能被 1$$$1$$$ 整除的下标，我们选择下标 6$$$6$$$，由于它能被 1$$$1$$$ 整除且之前尚未被选择，评测器将输出 1$$$1$$$，以确认所选下标有效。注意，如果我们改为选择 1$$$1$$$，评测器将输出 0$$$0$$$(因为它之前已经被选择过)。

在第三次查询中，我们必须选择一个能被 2$$$2$$$ 整除的下标，我们选择下标 4$$$4$$$，由于它能被 2$$$2$$$ 整除且之前尚未被选择，评测器将输出 1$$$1$$$，以确认所选下标有效。注意，如果我们改为选择 6$$$6$$$，评测器将输出 0$$$0$$$(因为它之前已经被选择过)；如果我们选择 3$$$3$$$，评测器也将输出 0$$$0$$$(因为它不能被 2$$$2$$$ 整除)。
注意，在所有由两个能被 1 整除的下标和一个能被 2 整除的下标组成的组合中，可能的最大结果是 15（这与样例中的结果相同），并且所有选中的下标都互不相同且满足整除条件，因此该结果被认为是正确的。
